proposal.summary: Eclipse Mosquitto 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16 contains a memory leak reachable remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs and does not respond to PUBREC; the leak is due to mishandling of EAGAIN from the libc send function.
proposal.cwe_quote: has a memory leak that can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs, and fails to respond to PUBREC commands.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request or test a vendor-provided patch or fixed version and verify memory usage under simulated QoS 2 duplicate-message-id flood; if patch unavailable, recommend rate-limiting or connection limits for clients.

evidence_quotes.claim: Description of affected versions and vulnerability
evidence_quotes.quote: The broker in Eclipse Mosquitto 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16 has a memory leak
can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs, and fails to respond to PUBREC commands.
This occurs because of mishandling of EAGAIN from the libc send function.
